id.instruksi: Lihat ke luar jendela kelas, lalu pasang simbol cuaca yang cocok di papan cuaca.
id.t-cerah1: Lapangan sekolah terang, langit biru tanpa awan.
id.t-cerah2: Teman-teman menyipitkan mata karena silau matahari.
id.t-cerah3: Bayangan tiang bendera terlihat jelas di lapangan.
id.t-mendung1: Langit di atas sekolah abu-abu, matahari tidak terlihat, tanah masih kering.
id.t-mendung2: Awan tebal dan gelap menutupi langit, tapi belum ada tetes air.
id.t-hujan1: Atap sekolah berbunyi tik-tik-tik dan kaca jendela basah.
id.t-hujan2: Lapangan penuh genangan dan air terus jatuh dari langit.
id.t-hujan3: Penjaga sekolah berjalan memakai payung dan jas hujan.
id.t-angin1: Tidak hujan, tapi bendera di tiang sekolah berkibar kencang.
id.t-angin2: Pohon di halaman sekolah bergoyang kencang dan kertas beterbangan.
id.t-angin3: Rambut teman-teman berantakan tertiup angin kencang.
id.t-cerah4: Murid-murid memakai topi karena matahari terik.

en.instruksi: Look out of the classroom window, then put the matching weather symbol on the weather board.
en.t-cerah1: The schoolyard is bright, the sky is blue with no clouds.
en.t-cerah2: Friends squint because the sun is so bright.
en.t-cerah3: The flagpole's shadow is clear on the field.
en.t-mendung1: The sky over school is grey, the sun is hidden, the ground is still dry.
en.t-mendung2: Thick dark clouds cover the sky, but no drops yet.
en.t-hujan1: The school roof goes tap-tap-tap and the window is wet.
en.t-hujan2: The field is full of puddles and water keeps falling from the sky.
en.t-hujan3: The school guard walks with an umbrella and a raincoat.
en.t-angin1: It isn't raining, but the school flag flaps hard.
en.t-angin2: The schoolyard trees sway hard and papers fly around.
en.t-angin3: Everyone's hair is messy from the strong wind.
en.t-cerah4: The pupils wear hats because the sun is hot.
